name: Salesforce
one_liner: Enterprise CRM platform for sales pipelines, customer records, and custom objects.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Web Server, JWT Bearer, Client Credentials)
auth_notes: No static API keys; requires Connected App or External Client App in Setup for Consumer Key/Secret.
gating_details: Free Developer Edition and sandboxes are self-serve; production customer orgs require org admin Connected App permissions.

api_surface.summary: SObject REST, Bulk 2.0, GraphQL, SOQL/SOSL, Metadata, and Streaming/PubSub APIs.

mcp_details: Official hosted Agentforce/Salesforce MCP + DX MCP server supporting OAuth and field-level security.
blocker_detail: None — free Developer Edition and standard OAuth2 Connected Apps enable full toolkit builds.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Inbound CRM, marketing automation, and customer engagement suite.
auth_notes: Legacy static API keys were sunsetted; single-account integrations use scoped Private App Bearer tokens.
gating_details: Free Developer Account and Free CRM tier allow instant app creation and Private App token generation.

api_surface.summary: CRM objects, pipelines, engagements, marketing emails, workflows, and custom objects.

mcp_details: Official HubSpot hosted MCP server with OAuth over standard and custom CRM objects.
blocker_detail: None — free developer portal with instant OAuth2 and Private App tokens.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 listed legacy API Keys as active; verified docs confirm legacy static API keys were sunsetted in favor of Private App Bearer tokens.

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Sales pipeline and deal-tracking CRM built for SMB and mid-market revenue teams.
auth_notes: Personal API tokens use x-api-token header; public Marketplace apps must use OAuth2.
gating_details: Self-serve Developer Hub and sandbox accounts available; no permanent free tier (14-day trial).

api_surface.summary: REST v1/v2 for deals, persons, organizations, activities, pipelines, and webhooks.

mcp_details: Official native remote MCP hosted at https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp using OAuth.
blocker_detail: None — instant Developer Sandbox and clean OAuth2/API token surface.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 marked MCP as Community-only; targeted MCP verification discovered official native remote MCP at mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp.

name: Attio
one_liner: Data-driven, customizable CRM with programmable objects, lists, and enrichment.
auth_notes: Single-workspace API keys and multi-tenant OAuth2 both pass Authorization: Bearer <token>.
gating_details: Free tier and instant developer settings for API keys and OAuth apps.

api_surface.summary: Objects, records, lists, attributes, notes, tasks, and workspace webhooks.

mcp_details: Official Attio remote MCP server over OAuth for searching, reading, and updating records/lists.
blocker_detail: None — clean OpenAPI-style REST endpoints with granular OAuth scopes and free tier.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source modern CRM generating dynamic REST and GraphQL APIs from workspace schemas.
auth_notes: Supports RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration plus workspace API keys via Settings > Developers.
gating_details: Open-source self-hostable for free plus self-serve Cloud workspaces.

api_surface.summary: Schema-per-tenant Core REST/GraphQL APIs plus Metadata API for custom objects and fields.

mcp_details: Native MCP server built directly into Twenty Cloud and open-source codebase over OAuth.
blocker_detail: None — open-source, self-serve API keys, DCR OAuth2, and native MCP.

name: Podio
one_liner: Customizable workspace and low-code CRM/app platform by Progress.
auth_notes: Non-standard Authorization: OAuth2 <token> header prefix; 8h access / 28d refresh tokens; role-based permissions instead of granular OAuth scopes.
gating_details: Free tier up to 5 employees and self-serve API key creation inside workspace settings.

api_surface.summary: Organizations, spaces, dynamic app items, tasks, comments, files, and hooks.

mcp_details: No first-party Progress/Podio MCP; bridged via Zapier, Pipedream, Activepieces, or Procfu MCPs.
blocker_detail: Non-standard 'OAuth2' header scheme and dynamic per-app field schemas without granular OAuth scopes.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: Full-featured SMB-to-enterprise CRM part of the Zoho business software suite.
auth_notes: Exclusively OAuth2 across multi-region DCs (.com/.eu/.in/.au); 1-hour access tokens; no static API keys.
gating_details: Free Edition (up to 3 users) includes API access capped at 5,000 daily API credits.

api_surface.summary: Leads, contacts, deals, custom modules, COQL SQL-like queries, bulk APIs, and notifications.

mcp_details: Official Zoho CRM MCP suite (4 servers: Data Insights, Data Operations, Module Customization, Workflow Rules).
blocker_detail: Multi-datacenter OAuth endpoint routing and daily credit caps on free tier.

name: Close
one_liner: Inside-sales CRM with built-in calling, SMS, and email sequences.
auth_notes: Instant API keys via HTTP Basic Auth (key:blank); OAuth2 for multi-tenant public integrations.
gating_details: 14-day self-serve trial (no permanent free tier); API access included from the lowest Solo/Basic plan.

api_surface.summary: Leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, calls, emails, sequences, and smart views.

mcp_details: Official remote MCP at https://mcp.close.com/mcp with DCR OAuth2 and scoped MCP permissions.
blocker_detail: None — clean REST API, instant API key/OAuth2, and native DCR MCP server.

name: Copper
one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM focused on relationship and pipeline management.
auth_notes: API keys require 3 custom headers; OAuth2 is restricted primarily to approved marketplace partners.
gating_details: 14-day free trial (no free plan); API enabled across paid plans with universal 180 req/min limit.

api_surface.summary: People, companies, opportunities, leads, projects, tasks, and activities.

mcp_details: No official first-party MCP server; requires custom REST wrapper or 3P workflow connector.
blocker_detail: Triple-header auth for keys and OAuth2 gated to marketplace partners; no permanent free tier.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Capital-markets and private equity deal/relationship management platform by Intapp.
auth_notes: REST client uses site-scoped Client Credentials; MCP uses per-user OAuth.
gating_details: Swagger/OpenAPI docs are public, but tenant sandboxes, API credentials, and Publications API require enterprise customer/partner provisioning.

api_surface.summary: Schema metadata, entry CRUD, cell values, user management, GraphQL queries, and Publications CDC stream.

mcp_details: Official read-only DealCloud MCP server exposing search, entry_details, and GraphQL introspection.
blocker_detail: No self-serve sandbox or trial; requires enterprise site access and admin/partner provisioning (403 otherwise).

pass1_issues: Pass 1 assumed no MCP and closed docs; verified docs show public OpenAPI + GraphQL + read-only official MCP, while tenant provisioning remains partner-gated.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Enterprise omnichannel customer service, ticketing, and help center platform.
auth_notes: OAuth2 managed in Admin Center; legacy API tokens face tightening deprecation timelines.
gating_details: Free trial and developer sandbox accounts available via Zendesk Developer Portal; paid plans for production.

api_surface.summary: Ticketing, users, organizations, Help Center, Talk, Sunshine Conversations, and custom objects.

mcp_details: Native Zendesk Bridge / MCP integration plus certified partner servers (e.g. Swifteq) over OAuth.
blocker_detail: None — mature REST APIs, developer sandboxes, and standard OAuth2.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 treated static API tokens as co-equal long-term auth; verified docs note API token deprecation tightening in favor of OAuth2.

name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer messaging, support inbox, and AI agent (Fin) platform.
auth_notes: Developer Hub supports instant workspace Access Tokens and multi-tenant OAuth apps.
gating_details: 14-day free trial (no permanent free plan; paid from $29/seat/mo); API included on standard plans.

api_surface.summary: Conversations, contacts, companies, tickets, articles, tags, and data events.

mcp_details: Official Streamable HTTP remote MCP at https://mcp.intercom.com/mcp (and EU mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp).
blocker_detail: None — self-serve Developer Hub, well-documented REST API, and hosted MCP.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Cloud helpdesk and multi-channel ticketing system by Freshworks.
auth_methods: Basic Auth (API Key as username, 'X' password)
auth_notes: API v2 and Freshworks Freshdesk MCP authenticate strictly via API keys (not OAuth2).
gating_details: Free tier includes REST API access; official Freshworks MCP integration requires Growth/Pro/Enterprise tiers.

api_surface.summary: Tickets, contacts, companies, agents, SLA policies, time entries, and solution articles.

mcp_details: Native GA Freshworks MCP integration on Growth+ plans authenticated via API key.
blocker_detail: None — free tier available and straightforward Basic API key authentication.

name: Front
one_liner: Collaborative shared inbox and customer operations hub for teams.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 for multi-tenant apps and personal/scoped API Bearer tokens.
gating_details: No permanent free tier (plans from $25/user/mo; trial available); advanced automation/webhooks gated by plan tier.

api_surface.summary: Conversations, messages, channels, shared inboxes, teammates, rules, and custom fields.

mcp_details: Official Open Beta remote MCP at https://mcp.frontapp.com/mcp plus Admin MCP over OAuth.
blocker_detail: Minor friction: no permanent free tier (requires trial or paid seat to test live workspace).

pass1_issues: Pass 1 reported Front MCP as Community/Self-hosted only; targeted verification found official remote MCP at mcp.frontapp.com/mcp.

name: Pylon
one_liner: B2B customer support platform unifying Slack, MS Teams, email, and ticketing.
auth_notes: REST API uses Admin-generated Bearer tokens with strict US/EU regional base URL routing; MCP adds user OAuth2.
gating_details: No free tier; B2B plans start at $89/seat/mo and require workspace Admin role to mint REST tokens.

api_surface.summary: Issues, accounts, contacts, messages, custom fields, and knowledge base articles.

mcp_details: Official hosted MCP at https://mcp.usepylon.com (and EU) supporting OAuth2 or Bearer token.
blocker_detail: No free tier ($89/seat+); REST API lacks OAuth2 (admin org token only + regional URL split).

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Multi-channel helpdesk, live chat, and call center ticketing software.
auth_notes: REST v3 uses custom 'apikey' header; built-in MCP server adds OAuth 2.1 or scoped MCP tokens.
gating_details: Limited Free tier + trial available; full hooks and multi-department features on paid plans ($15+/agent).

api_surface.summary: OpenAPI v3 endpoints for tickets, agents, contacts, canned messages, calls, and chats (180 req/min).

mcp_details: Built-in LiveAgent MCP server configurable under AI Agents / System API with OAuth 2.1.
blocker_detail: None — OpenAPI v3 Swagger docs, free tier, and built-in MCP.

name: Plain
one_liner: API-first B2B customer support platform built entirely on a public GraphQL schema.
auth_notes: Scoped machine-user API keys via Bearer header; OAuth apps for user-delegated and MCP flows.
gating_details: 7-day free trial without credit card (no permanent free plan); API and MCP included across all paid tiers.

api_surface.summary: Full UI parity via GraphQL API, downloadable schema.graphql, and official @team-plain/graphql TypeScript SDK.

mcp_details: Official hosted OAuth MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp.
blocker_detail: None — full GraphQL UI parity, official TS SDK, and hosted MCP.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Customer support shared inbox, knowledge base (Docs), and live chat platform.
auth_notes: Split auth: Inbox API v2 uses OAuth2 (Code + Client Credentials), while Docs API v1 uses HTTP Basic API keys.
gating_details: Self-serve Standard/Plus/Pro plans required for API access (trial available; reporting endpoints gated to Plus+).

api_surface.summary: Conversations, mailboxes, customers, threads, workflows, and Docs knowledge base articles.

mcp_details: Official remote MCP at https://mcp.helpscout.net/mcp (OAuth for Inbox; Docs key required for Docs tools).
blocker_detail: Split auth model between Inbox (OAuth2) and Docs (Basic API key), plus paid plan gate.

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused customer support helpdesk with deep Shopify/Magento order context.
auth_notes: Self-serve Basic Auth via email:api_key on all plans; OAuth2 reserved for Gorgias Partner apps.
gating_details: 7-day trial (no free tier); REST API keys included on all paid plans starting at $10/mo.

api_surface.summary: Tickets, messages, customers, macros, rules, tags, and HTTP integrations.

mcp_details: Official Gorgias MCP server in Open Beta connecting Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
blocker_detail: None — API access across all plans with straightforward Basic Auth and official Beta MCP.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 flagged Gorgias as Community/Composio-only MCP; targeted verification found official Gorgias MCP (Open Beta).

name: Gladly
one_liner: Enterprise person-centric customer service platform for high-volume retail and B2C brands.
auth_methods: Basic Auth / Bearer Token (Org-domain REST API)
auth_notes: Credentials and developer sandboxes provisioned via Customer Success / organization admins.
gating_details: No free tier or self-serve trial; enterprise demo-led contracts (~$180+/agent, 10+ seat minimums) required for sandbox and API.

api_surface.summary: Customers, conversations, tasks, Lookup API adapters, and agent/topic endpoints (10 req/s default).

mcp_details: Official Gladly MCP for Claude (enterprise org-scoped) plus outbound MCP connections inside Gladly AI.
blocker_detail: Enterprise sales/CS provisioning gate — no self-serve sandbox or free developer account.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 missed Gladly's official enterprise MCP integration ('Gladly MCP for Claude') and assumed 3P-only middleware.

name: Slack
one_liner: Workplace messaging, channels, workflows, and app platform.
auth_notes: Self-serve App creation at api.slack.com/apps; tiered rate limits (1 msg/s per channel; Tier 1-4).
gating_details: Free workspaces allow up to 10 custom/3P apps; Enterprise Grid audit/discovery APIs require enterprise plans.

api_surface.summary: Web API, Events API, Socket Mode, Block Kit, canvases, files, and Slack CLI.

mcp_details: Official Slack MCP server (mcp.slack.com/mcp) authenticated via scoped OAuth2 user tokens.
blocker_detail: None — gold-standard self-serve OAuth2 portal and official MCP.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Programmable SMS, voice, WhatsApp, verification, and communications APIs.
auth_methods: Basic Auth (Account SID + Auth Token / API Key+Secret)
auth_notes: AccountSID:AuthToken or API Key SID:Secret over HTTP Basic; production SMS requires A2P 10DLC/regulatory compliance.
gating_details: Self-serve trial credits (100 SMS, 75 voice min) restricted to verified phone numbers until funded.

api_surface.summary: Programmable Messaging, Voice, Verify, Lookup, Conversations, Flex, and official SDKs.

mcp_details: Official Twilio Labs MCP monorepo (twilio-labs/mcp, @twilio-alpha/mcp) via npx and Claude connector.
blocker_detail: None for API build; carrier A2P registration applies to live US SMS senders.

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team chat, channels, bots, and video messaging app in the Zoho ecosystem.
auth_notes: Centralized Zoho API Console OAuth2 with regional DC URLs (.com/.eu/.in) and 1h access tokens.
gating_details: Free tier available with self-serve OAuth registration.

api_surface.summary: Channels, direct messages, threads, bots, slash commands, reminders, and user directory.

mcp_details: Official Zoho Cliq MCP hosted via Zoho MCP Platform (mcp.zoho.com).
blocker_detail: Multi-datacenter OAuth endpoint selection required per user region.
evidence_title: Zoho Cliq REST API v2 Docs

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: All-in-one enterprise collaboration suite combining chat, docs, Base, calendar, and approvals.
auth_notes: Dual-token architecture: App ID/Secret mints tenant_access_token; OAuth2 yields user_access_token.
gating_details: Free Starter plan (up to 20 users) with free Unlimited core APIs; Advanced APIs metered on Pro/Enterprise.

api_surface.summary: Messenger, Docs, Sheets, Base (tables), Calendar, Contacts, Drive, and Approvals.

mcp_details: Official open-source lark-openapi-mcp supporting stdio/SSE and dual user/tenant tokens.
blocker_detail: Dual tenant vs user token switching and Lark/Feishu regional domain split.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Free team chat and workplace messaging platform by CAKE.com.
auth_notes: Apps use x-app-token + user/bot token; workspace API add-on supports static API keys (1,000 req/min).
gating_details: Free tier includes unlimited users, message history, and the API add-on.

api_surface.summary: Messages, channels, reactions, files, users, and Pumble App SDK manifests.

mcp_details: Official remote MCP at https://mcp.pumble.com/mcp using token and x-app-token headers.
blocker_detail: None — free API add-on, 1,000 req/min limit, and official remote MCP.

name: Discord
one_liner: Real-time voice, video, and community text chat platform with bot ecosystem.
auth_notes: Bot actions use static Bot Token; user identity and server installation use OAuth2.
gating_details: 100% free self-serve Developer Portal; privileged Gateway intents require verification above 75-100 servers.

api_surface.summary: Guilds, channels, messages, slash commands, threads, roles, voice states, and WebSocket Gateway.

mcp_details: No monolithic official Discord MCP; widely implemented via community/Composio/Pipedream MCPs.
blocker_detail: None — free instant Bot tokens and OAuth2.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Cloud messaging platform featuring instant self-serve HTTP bot APIs.
auth_notes: Bot API embeds <token> directly in URL path; zero OAuth handshake needed for bots.
gating_details: Completely free and instant self-serve via @BotFather.

api_surface.summary: Messages, inline keyboards, media, polls, payments, mini-apps, and webhook/long-poll updates.

mcp_details: No first-party Telegram MCP; numerous open-source and platform-hosted Bot API MCPs.
blocker_detail: None — instant zero-cost token minting via @BotFather.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Enterprise customer messaging API over Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform.
auth_notes: Meta Graph API Bearer tokens; production requires verified Meta Business Portfolio and phone registration.
gating_details: Free sandbox test numbers are self-serve, but production messaging requires Business Verification, template approval, and payment method.

api_surface.summary: Cloud API for messages, templates, media, WABA management, and webhook status callbacks.

mcp_details: Official Meta WhatsApp Business Tools MCP for WABA discovery, template CRUD, and test messaging.
blocker_detail: Meta Business Portfolio verification, phone number ownership, and message template approvals block instant production.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 classified WhatsApp Business as Self-Serve Free based on Meta App creation; verified docs show production requires Business Verification, phone checks, and template approval.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud voice phone system and call center platform integrated with CRMs.
auth_methods: Basic Auth (API ID + API Token Base64)
auth_notes: Dashboard API keys use Basic Auth; public multi-tenant OAuth2 requires Aircall Tech Partner Program approval.
gating_details: 7-day trial only; full API & webhooks require Professional plan ($50+/user/mo), and public OAuth requires Tech Partner approval.

api_surface.summary: Calls, contacts, users, teams, numbers, tags, and webhooks (10,000 record list cap).

mcp_details: No official Aircall MCP (publishes developer.aircall.io/llms.txt); community MCP servers wrap REST API.
blocker_detail: Public OAuth2 requires Tech Partner Program approval and full API requires Professional plan.

name: Vonage
one_liner: CPaaS communications APIs for SMS, voice, video, verify, and network insights.
auth_notes: Mixes API Key/Secret (SMS/Verify) with application-signed JWTs (Voice/Messages).
gating_details: Self-serve developer signup with free trial credits and pay-as-you-go billing.

api_surface.summary: Messages, SMS, Voice, Verify, Video, Number Insight, and multi-language SDKs.

mcp_details: Official Vonage MCP servers for tool discovery, docs, and server API execution.
blocker_detail: None — instant self-serve API credentials and official MCP tooling.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic campaign management and GAQL reporting for Google Search, YouTube, and Display ads.
auth_notes: Requires both OAuth2 credentials AND a Google-approved MCC Developer Token.
gating_details: Test accounts are self-serve, but Basic/Standard Developer Tokens for production accounts require Google compliance & design doc review.

api_surface.summary: GAQL reporting, campaigns, ad groups, keywords, bidding, conversions, and gRPC/REST endpoints.

mcp_details: Official Google Ads MCP server (strictly read-only GAQL queries via ADC/OAuth proxy).
blocker_detail: Mandatory MCC Developer Token approval (Basic/Standard review) plus OAuth verification for ad scopes.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Advertising, audience targeting, and campaign insights API across Facebook and Instagram.
auth_notes: Meta Graph API tokens; production ads_management/ads_read scopes require Meta App Review.
gating_details: Self-serve sandbox/own-account testing, but multi-customer production requires Meta Business Verification and App Review.

api_surface.summary: Marketing API for campaigns, ad sets, creatives, custom audiences, Conversions API, and Insights.

mcp_details: Official Meta Ads MCP (mcp.facebook.com/ads) supporting read/write (new ads default to paused).
blocker_detail: Meta App Review + Business Verification required for multi-tenant ads_management scopes.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: B2B sponsored content, lead-gen forms, and campaign analytics API on LinkedIn.
auth_notes: Requires explicit product approval for Advertising API (Development -> Standard tier via video demo).
gating_details: Must apply in LinkedIn Developer Portal for Advertising API access and submit a video demo for Standard tier.

api_surface.summary: Ad accounts, campaigns, creatives, analytics reporting, DMP segments, and lead gen forms.

mcp_details: No official LinkedIn Ads MCP; community servers (e.g. ZenABM) wrap Marketing API.
blocker_detail: LinkedIn Advertising API requires application review + video demo before multi-tenant production access.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: White-label agency CRM, marketing funnels, SMS/email automation, and calendar platform.
auth_notes: API v1 deprecated; v2 uses OAuth2 for multi-subaccount apps and PITs for single accounts.
gating_details: 14-day trial (no free plan); API v2 included across core Starter/Unlimited plans; public Marketplace apps require review.

api_surface.summary: Contacts, opportunities, calendars, conversations, funnels, invoices, and sub-accounts.

mcp_details: Official GHL/LeadConnector MCP at https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2 via OAuth.
blocker_detail: No permanent free plan (14-day trial) and multi-level agency/sub-account OAuth scoping.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing, audience segmentation, and transactional messaging (Mandrill) platform.
auth_notes: API keys embed datacenter suffix (e.g. -us20); OAuth2 returns metadata endpoint to resolve DC.
gating_details: Free tier includes API key creation and Marketing API access; Transactional (Mandrill) is a paid add-on.

api_surface.summary: Audiences, lists, segments, campaigns, automations, ecommerce stores, and Mandrill transactional.

mcp_details: Official Transactional MCP at https://mandrillapp.com/mcp (Bearer); Marketing API relies on community MCPs.
blocker_detail: None — instant self-serve API keys, OAuth2, and free tier.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Ecommerce customer data, email/SMS automation, and event-driven marketing platform.
auth_notes: JSON:API v2024+ with granular scoped Private Keys and public OAuth2 app flow.
gating_details: Permanent Free Plan (up to 250 active profiles, 500 emails/mo) includes full API & webhook access.

api_surface.summary: Profiles, events, metrics, lists, segments, campaigns, flows, catalogs, and templates.

mcp_details: Official Klaviyo MCP server (klaviyo-mcp-server via uvx and remote mcp.klaviyo.com/mcp).
blocker_detail: None — open API on free tier, clean JSON:API specs, and official MCP.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one sales funnel builder, email marketing, and online course platform.
auth_methods: Bearer / PAT (Public API Key & Dedicated MCP Key)
auth_notes: Static Bearer tokens generated under Settings > MCP & API keys (max 3 active keys).
gating_details: Permanent Freemium plan includes public API and MCP key generation.

api_surface.summary: Contacts, tags, custom fields, courses, products, orders, and subscriptions.

mcp_details: Official Systeme.io MCP at https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=... documented at developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server.
blocker_detail: None — free plan, self-serve API & MCP keys, and straightforward REST.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 reported no official MCP (Zapier/Activepieces only); verified docs found native MCP server at mcp.systeme.io/mcp.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: Visual discovery and social pin/board publishing and ads platform.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Authorization Code, Client Credentials; pina_/pinr_ tokens)
auth_notes: API v5 uses OAuth2 with continuous 60-day refresh tokens; production scopes require app review.
gating_details: Self-serve developer portal with Trial access; Standard production access requires app review.

api_surface.summary: Pins, boards, media uploads, user analytics, catalogs, and Pinterest Ads v5.

mcp_details: Internal Pinterest MCPs exist, but no public official Pinterest MCP server; 3P/community only.
blocker_detail: Trial access is self-serve, but Standard production multi-user access requires Pinterest app review.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Meta's public text/media microblogging and conversation social platform.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Meta App-Scoped Threads User Access Tokens)
auth_notes: 1h short-lived tokens exchanged for 90d refreshable long-lived tokens via graph.threads.net.
gating_details: Self-serve test users in Meta App Dashboard; publishing for external users requires Meta App Review.

api_surface.summary: Publishing text/image/video/carousel posts, replies, profiles, and insights via graph.threads.net.

mcp_details: Excluded from Meta's official MCP offerings (unlike Meta Ads and WhatsApp); community wrappers only.
blocker_detail: Requires Meta App Review for external user scopes (threads_content_publish).

pass1_issues: Pass 1 assumed Meta's official MCP covered Threads alongside Meta Ads; targeted check confirmed Threads has no official Meta MCP.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Cloud transactional and marketing email delivery platform by Twilio.
auth_notes: Basic user/password deprecated due to mandatory 2FA; scoped SG. API keys via Bearer header.
gating_details: Free trial / limited free tier with instant self-serve API key creation; domain auth recommended.

api_surface.summary: Mail Send v3, dynamic templates, contacts, suppressions, inbound parse, and Event Webhooks.

mcp_details: Twilio hosts only a read-only docs-indexing MCP; sending/contact actions require community/3P MCPs.
blocker_detail: None — instant API keys, mature REST v3 OpenAPI specs, and straightforward Bearer auth.

pass1_issues: Pass 1 conflated Mailchimp Transactional MCP with SendGrid; verified Twilio only offers a read-only docs MCP for SendGrid.

name: Shopify
one_liner: Leading cloud commerce platform for online storefronts, orders, and headless retail.
auth_notes: GraphQL Admin API is primary; X-Shopify-Access-Token for custom store apps, OAuth2 for App Store apps.
gating_details: Free Shopify Partner account allows unlimited Development Stores with full API access.

api_surface.summary: Admin GraphQL, Storefront GraphQL, Customer Account API, Payments, Functions, and Webhooks.

mcp_details: Official storefront/UCP MCP (/api/ucp/mcp) plus @shopify/dev-mcp for schema/docs.
blocker_detail: None — free Partner dev stores, world-class GraphQL docs, and native MCP.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Open-source WordPress ecommerce plugin powering self-hosted online stores.
auth_methods: Basic Auth (ck_/cs_ Consumer Keys over HTTPS)
auth_notes: Store admins generate ck_/cs_ REST keys in WooCommerce Settings; newer MCP uses WP Application Passwords.
gating_details: 100% free open-source plugin; self-hosted store owners generate keys directly.

api_surface.summary: WP REST /wp-json/wc/v3 for products, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, and webhooks.

mcp_details: Official WordPress MCP Adapter plugin (developer preview) exposing WooCommerce abilities via STDIO/HTTP.
blocker_detail: None — free OSS plugin with instant ck_/cs_ REST keys (note: each store has its own base domain).

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: SaaS ecommerce and headless commerce engine for mid-market and enterprise brands.
auth_notes: Uses client_id, client_secret, and X-Auth-Token access tokens across REST and GraphQL.
gating_details: Self-serve trial and Partner sandbox stores available immediately.

api_surface.summary: Catalog v3, Orders v2/v3, Customers, Checkout, Storefront GraphQL, and Admin GraphQL.

mcp_details: Official Storefront MCP and Store Management MCP servers.
blocker_detail: None — instant API accounts, sandbox stores, and official MCP.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Enterprise B2C and B2B cloud commerce suite (SFCC) with SCAPI/OCAPI APIs.
auth_notes: Account Manager issues OAuth2 tokens for Admin SCAPI/OCAPI; SLAS issues JWTs for shopper endpoints.
